title: Parallax harness result (protocol v1)
description: The single JSON document the harness writes to the container's stdout, framed by the job nonce (docs/design/runner.md §4.4). The runner validates it before trusting any field, then wraps it in the outcome it stores as the pg-boss job output.

harnessVersion.description: Integer version of runner/harness, as a string; part of the grader version.

version.description: Interpreter version as reported by it, e.g. 3.12.8 or 4.6.1.

compileError.description: Present when a file failed to parse before any check ran; every check is then `skipped`.

checks.description: One entry per job check, in job order, names copied from the job.

truncated.description: True when any captured stdout or stderr was cut at its cap.

durationMs.description: Wall time from harness start to result, including the compile phase.

status.description: `passed`/`failed`: the program ran and the comparison decided. `error`: it did not run to a comparable end (exception, exit code, signal, memory, could not start). `timeout`: killed at its time cap. `skipped`: not run (compile error or budget already spent).

errorKind.description: Only with status `error`. `exception`: uncaught exception in a call check. `exit`: unexpected exit code. `signal`: killed by a signal other than the memory killer. `memory`: killed while the cgroup recorded an out-of-memory kill. `spawn`: the process could not be started (for example the pids limit). `harness`: a harness fault for this check.

expected.description: Human-readable expectation (JSON, repr or stdout excerpt), at most 2048 characters, cut with an ellipsis.

actual.description: What the program produced, in the same form as `expected`.

message.description: One line for the student, e.g. `Expected 1.290994, received None` or `Line 2 differs`.
